title: Governance

## Maintainer

The project is maintained by Shain Singh
([shain.singh@owasp.org](mailto:shain.singh@owasp.org)). The maintainer
reviews and merges every pull request; auto-merge is never enabled on
the maintainer's behalf.

## Working agreement

- Conventional Commits on every commit subject and pull-request title,
  checked by a CI gate.
- Signed commits: the OpenPGP key
  `9CB1781DC2BB28D37A0155DCAAF8226F3F4C1712` (OWASP identity); the
  `protect-default` ruleset rejects unsigned commits. Releases carry
  signed tags.
- One logical change per branch, merged by pull request; direct pushes
  to `main` do not happen.

## Architecture Decision Records

Structured decisions live in `docs/adr/`; accepted records are immutable
and are superseded only by newer ones.

| Record | Decision | Status |
|---|---|---|
| [ADR-0000](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/docs/adr/0000-architecture-decision-records.md) | The ADR process: what carries an ADR, immutability, supersession | accepted |
| [ADR-0001](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/docs/adr/0001-foundational-decisions.md) | Foundational decisions: the read-only invariant, the event contract, Rust and aya | accepted |
| [ADR-0002](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/docs/adr/0002-release-gates.md) | Release gates: three scenarios, each with its measure | accepted |

Most slices are leaf-sized — the issue plus its linked spec sections are
the design record. Release signing and provenance are
[normative in the specification](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/docs/spec.md#171-release-signing-and-provenance)
(§17.1), not an ADR.

## Supply chain: SLSA provenance and attestation

Every release asset carries **SLSA build provenance**, generated keylessly
in-job by GitHub Artifact Attestations
([spec §17.1](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/docs/spec.md#171-release-signing-and-provenance)):
Sigstore-signed, bound to this repository's OID issuer, published to the
public attestation log. The build configuration is Build Level 2
(ephemeral, source-declared, hosted runners); Build Level 3 arrives when
the build moves behind an isolated shared reusable workflow, and no
claim rises above the declared level. The release tag is signed
(`git tag -s`) and points at the gate pull request's merge commit; the
release workflow refuses a tag without its committed gate report.

Browse the artifact attestations on GitHub:
[github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/attestations](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/attestations).
Every entry pins the artifact digest and points at the release workflow run
that built it.

Verify any release binary before running it:

```bash
gh attestation verify agentpcap-linux-amd64 -R shsingh/agentpcap
```

The verification contract: the artifact's digest must match a provenance
record whose repository and workflow identity resolve to
`shsingh/agentpcap`; anything unsigned or unprovable is not distributed.

## Automated posture

| Control | Status |
|---|---|
| Secret scanning + push protection | enabled (repo settings) |
| Dependency Review on every PR | active (`dependency-review.yml`) |
| OpenSSF Scorecard | scheduled (`scorecards.yml`) |
| Spec render (text, HTML, PDF) on source changes | active (`spec-render.yml`); outputs never committed |
| Site checks on every PR | active (`site-check.yml`) |
| PR title gate (Conventional Commits) | active (`pr-title-gate.yml`) |
| Release build + SLSA attestation | on release tags (`release.yml`) |
| Branch ruleset (signatures, PR-only, checks) | active (`protect-default`) |

## Test receipts

Work moves in red-green pairs and the receipts are the deliverable; the
[TDD cell matrix](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/tests/matrix/LEDGER.md)
records every cell with its named red and its fresh, VM-run green. A
green without a run receipt does not count.

## Licence posture

The project carries the [MIT licence](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/LICENSE)
for its original code. Third-party sources keep their own terms; the
inventory and the inheritance analysis live in
[NOTICE.md](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/NOTICE.md).
MIT and Apache-2.0 are both permissive; Apache-2.0 sources may ride
inside an MIT project when their notices travel with them.

## Specification governance

The canonical specification is
[`docs/spec.md`](https://github.com/shsingh/agentpcap/blob/main/docs/spec.md)
in the mmark dialect; CI renders it to text, HTML and PDF on every
source push. The event schema and the ledger format are the interface
contract; incompatible changes bump `schema_version` and carry a
migration note.
